Watch Chandragupta Maurya Episode - 24 now!
Synopsis :
Chanakya leaves no choice for Chandragupta except to become a spy for him and inform him about every incident of the Magadha palace. Chandragupta gives his words to him that he will do as per his instructions. The moment Chandragupta enters the premises of the Magadha palace, Bhadrasaal takes him where Dhananand is waiting for him. Dhananand makes him swear his loyalty to him and asks him to protect Durdhara at any cost. Later, Mura has an argument with Chandragupta and she refuses to bow down in front of Dhananand.
